What does it take to go from failing Prelims twice to securing AIR 7 in UPSC CSE 2025?

In this exclusive conversation at Vajiram & Ravi, New Delhi, A.R. Rajah Mohaideen (UPSC CSE 2025 AIR 7) shares his inspiring journey—from being an MBBS graduate to achieving one of the top ranks in the Civil Services Examination. After not clearing the Prelims in his first two attempts, Rajah stayed persistent and turned his third attempt into a remarkable success, clearing Prelims, Mains, and Interview in the same cycle.

During the discussion, he reveals the strategies, mindset, and preparation techniques that helped him succeed in one of the toughest exams in the world.

🔹 Key insights from this conversation:
• How Rajah Mohaideen overcame failure in his first two attempts
• Why having a clear purpose for UPSC preparation is crucial
• The importance of single sources and mastering basic books
• Why solving UPSC Previous Year Questions (PYQs) is a game changer
• Strategy for Prelims, Mains answer writing, and Essay preparation
• Tips for UPSC Personality Test and Mock Interviews
• Habits school and college students should build early for UPSC

He also shares how witnessing the impact of IAS officers during the COVID-19 pandemic inspired him to pursue civil services and dedicate himself to public service.

This podcast is a must-watch for every UPSC aspirant looking for real preparation insights, motivation, and a practical strategy to crack the Civil Services Examination.

Subscribe for more UPSC Topper Talks, Mock Interviews, and Preparation Strategies from Vajiram & Ravi – India’s leading institute for Civil Services preparation.
